evidence.note: With no overlay present, the background diagram is already blurred into soft blue/red smudges and grey blocks; no node label, edge or legend text can be read.
Same heavy blur at the small size: only the vague shape of a diagram with a legend row is visible.
White insight card with soft drop shadow floats crisply over the blurred diagram; the card clearly has focus.
Three cards cover almost all of the diagram; only faint blurred legend fragments show below and between cards, and the context is effectively gone.
Same at the small size: the cards fill the body and the blurred context beneath is not identifiable.

rationale: The cards have clear focus thanks to their shadow and the blurred backdrop, so they do not compete with the content. But the blur is so heavy that the diagram beneath can't be recognised at any step, even at step 0 before any overlay appears. That matches the fail descriptor 'effects so heavy the context is lost'.
